verdict.rationale: Jira itself is an issue tracker without native document/notes authoring; evidence shows this capability is delivered only via integration with a separate product, Confluence (jira-docs-24), not within Jira's own UI. This is a real workaround requiring another tool rather than native support. Missing for 10: evidence of native doc/notes creation inside Jira, first-party docs describing an in-product wiki/notes feature, and independent confirmation that PMs can organize docs alongside issues without leaving Jira.
